claim_scope: The implication-only endomorphisms on all nonempty subsets of a labelled finite n-set, n>=2; their complete image-rank and idempotent-rank distributions.
integrity: Analytic proof plus self-contained exhaustive finite verification; no external independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The counted homomorphisms preserve material implication but need not extend to Boolean homomorphisms preserving the empty set; results are not asserted for other finite Tarski algebras. A 2012 directly related paper was available only by abstract, and prior general duality may imply portions. Finite computations cover n<=4; the proof covers all n>=2.
title: Image ranks and idempotent retractions of finite Tarski implication algebras
